name: data-table
title: Data table
description: A Table with a toolbar: search, filters, a column picker, bulk actions, paging or virtualization, and its view kept in the URL.

when: A record list people search, filter and act on in bulk: orders, customers, invoices.

instead.when: A short, fixed list with no tools.

keyboard.does: Moves between the toolbar, the table and the pager.

builtIn: Loading, empty, no-results and failed states have their own copy.
The selected count is announced in the bulk bar.
youProvide: An aria-label, and labels for filters and bulk actions.

DataTable.name: rowKey
DataTable.description:
The row's stable id; `row.id` by default. Selection is kept by it across pages. Ids must be unique within
the list; build one from the fields that are when the data has none (`${row.date}:${row.channel}`). A
repeated id on a page still renders every row: the later ones are keyed `a#2`, `a#3`, … in row order, and
selection, bulk actions and `onRowAction` receive those suffixed keys; a development warning names the
repeated ids. A suffixed key follows the row's position, not the row: after a sort, filter
or page change a selection made through it can move to another copy, and an id repeated on two pages is
one key, so selecting it on one page selects it on both.

DataTable.name: columnVisibility
DataTable.description: Column key → shown; columns left out are shown. Pass with `onColumnVisibilityChange` to own it.

DataTable.name: onRowAction
DataTable.description: Opens the record (row press while nothing is selected).

DataTable.name: formatRange
DataTable.type: (from: number, to: number, total: number) => string

DataTable.name: emptyState
DataTable.type: { title: string; description?: string | undefined; action?: ReactNode; }
DataTable.description: What an empty list says and the action that fills it (with no search or filter active).

DataTable.name: urlKey
DataTable.description: Prefixes the URL params (`orders.page`) when two tables share a page.

DataTable.name: searchParams
DataTable.description:
The URL's search params. Pass them when the page renders on the server (SSR): without them the server
reads no params while the browser reads `window.location.search`, and a URL with params hydrates with a
mismatch. A host router can also pass its current params here; the view follows when they change.

DataTable.name: routerOptions
DataTable.description: Passed to the provider's `navigate` with each view change (a host router's replace or scroll option).

DataTable.name: density
DataTable.description: `compact` (36px rows) by default: DataTable is the dense working list of a back office.

DataTable.name: query
DataTable.description:
A server list: fetches one page for the view; aborted when the view changes again. It is read when
the view changes, not when the function does: for a list that depends on something else (a parent
tab), give the DataTable a `key` from it so it starts afresh.

DataTable.name: rows
DataTable.description: A client list: searched, filtered and sorted here; paged, or virtualized when long.

DataTable.name: virtualizeAbove
DataTable.description: Client lists longer than this render only the rows in view instead of pages. 200 by default.

DataTable.name: height
DataTable.description: The virtualized list's height in px. 480 by default.
